meta.description: Document metadata. Beta.24 may include timeScale and persisted checkpoints. palette is the document's own palette: a palette name or {custom: [six #RRGGBB hexes]}; it wins over the view's palette when the document opens.

items.description: Component records may include Port Connection access: none | read | write | read-write.

attachmentDefaults.description: Legacy stored form of a 2D Component's port set. 'standard' (explicit, or implied on a typed template) = the template's declared ports followed by attachmentPoints as additions; 'none' = attachmentPoints is the complete list. A Plane's default is 'none'.

attachmentPoints.description: Declared ports: additions under 'standard', the complete list under 'none'.

members.description: On a group (symbolId 'group'): the ids of the Components it collects for reading, all on the group's canvas. A group is not a boundary: it hosts nothing and has no ports, and a Wire between members of different groups is one Wire. See SECTION-MODEL.md 'Groups (reading only)'.

status.description: The Component's status: the id of an entry in the statuses list of the document's notation (notation.statuses). There is no built-in list; a notation that declares no statuses admits none (STATUS_UNDECLARED), and an id it does not declare is STATUS_UNKNOWN. See NOTATION-MODEL.md 'Statuses'.

waitsOn.description: What the Component waits on: people, rules and decisions, each {kind, id, label?}. Drawn under the card beside the status the notation's statuses list declares; anything else is WAITS_ON_INVALID.

items.description: Wire config may include forwardOperation/reverseOperation: none | read | write.

status.description: The Wire's status: the id of an entry in the statuses list of the document's notation (notation.statuses). There is no built-in list; a notation that declares no statuses admits none (STATUS_UNDECLARED), and an id it does not declare is STATUS_UNKNOWN. See NOTATION-MODEL.md 'Statuses'.

waitsOn.description: What the Wire waits on: people, rules and decisions, each {kind, id, label?}. Drawn in the Wire's caption after the status the notation's statuses list declares; anything else is WAITS_ON_INVALID.

status.description: An id from the statuses list of the document's notation (notation.statuses); the values are the notation's, never a fixed set.

waitsOn.description: Typed references to what a Component or Wire waits on (people, rules and decisions), shown beside the status it takes from the notation's statuses list.

declaredPort.description: A declared 0D port on a 2D Component boundary. Edits supply t and flow; older files may omit t (0.5) and use defaultFlow in place of flow.

compatId.description: Legacy port-contract key (config.ports); defaults to id.

defaultFlow.description: Legacy alias of flow, read only when flow is absent; flow wins when both are present.

channels.description: Named channels, unique ids; absent means [{id:'main'}]. A Wire binds two ports only when they share a channel id.
